plugins.name: pipefy
plugins.description: Pipefy workflow automation for Claude Code. Connects to Pipefy's hosted MCP server (https://mcp.pipefy.com/mcp, browser OAuth sign-in) to manage pipes, cards, tables, reports, automations and AI agents, and bundles 17 skills for building and analyzing processes. Optional /pipefy:install installs the pipefy CLI from PyPI via uv; /pipefy:pipefy-login stores its OAuth session in the OS keychain.
